name: Synn
message: 「Alright... For now, I've done everything I can」

name: Synn
message: 「So I don't fall asleep during the real thing. Gotta get plenty of sleep the night before. You're looking pretty lively too, Sacchin」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep. Slept like a log over the long weekend」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Maybe I'll try cramming just a tiny bit more」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Trying to make everyone let their guard down, huh. Well, I'm not falling for it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The people who say they didn't study are always the ones who studied the hardest. They put up a smokescreen just to boost their own curve」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If the average score drops, the passing cutoff drops too, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I keep telling you, Sacchin, you always cut it way too close」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That thrill is just irresistible, you know~ It's like riding a roller coaster~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Then why don't you just treat studying like a game」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh. That might actually be a nice idea~」
Now then, there's still tomorrow... what should I do.
